title: C1 yakuniy imtihon
goal_uz: Dars oxirida C1 darajasining asosiy grammatikasi va akademik lug‘atini takrorlaysiz, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish bo‘yicha vaqtli topshiriqlarni bajarasiz, sertifikat talablarini bilasiz va 15 savolli imtihon testidan kamida 12 ball olasiz.

scenes.title: C1 yakuniy imtihoniga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Bugun C1 darajasining yakuniy darsi. Oldingi darsda to‘liq mock imtihonning gapirish va yozish qismlarini bajarib, o‘zingizni band mezonlari bo‘yicha baholadingiz. Bugun butun darajani tartib bilan takrorlaymiz, har bir ko‘nikma bo‘yicha vaqtli topshiriq bajaramiz, oxirida esa o‘n beshta savolli imtihon testi kutadi.
scenes.say: Welcome to the final lesson of level C1. Today we pull everything together, advanced grammar, academic vocabulary and all four skills, under exam conditions.
scenes.say_uz: C1 darajasining yakuniy darsiga xush kelibsiz. Bugun hammasini jamlaymiz: ilg‘or grammatika, akademik lug‘at va to‘rt ko‘nikma, imtihon sharoitida.

scenes.title: Bugungi reja
scenes.say_native: Reja shunday: strategiya, grammatika va lug‘at, so‘ng o‘qish, tinglash, talaffuz, yozish va gapirish. Har bir bo‘lim qisqa vaqtli topshiriq bilan tugaydi. Pauzalarda haqiqiy imtihondagidek ishlang: daftar va qalam tayyor tursin, javobni avval yozing, keyin tekshiring. Javobni eshitib “men ham shunday o‘ylagandim” deyish hisob emas.
scenes.say: Treat every pause as real exam time. Write your answer down before you hear mine.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir pauzaga haqiqiy imtihon vaqti deb qarang. Javobimni eshitishdan oldin o‘zingiznikini yozib qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Sertifikat talablari
board: Lesson test: pass mark 60% (9/15) · your target: 12/15
Certificate: after the C2 final exam
Final exam ≥ 80% + at least 70% of lessons passed
scenes.say_native: Sertifikat haqida aniq gapiraylik. C1 va C2 bitta kurs. Har bir dars testidan o‘tish uchun kamida oltmish foiz kerak, bugun bu o‘n beshdan to‘qqiz. Sertifikat esa kurs oxirida, C2 yakuniy imtihonidan keyin beriladi: u yerda kamida sakson foiz olishingiz va darslarning kamida yetmish foizidan o‘tgan bo‘lishingiz kerak. Shuning uchun bugun o‘n ikki ballni, ya’ni sakson foizni maqsad qiling. Sertifikat raqamini ish beruvchi internetda tekshira oladi.
scenes.say: The pass mark for each lesson test is sixty per cent. The certificate comes at the end of the course, after the C2 final exam, where you'll need eighty per cent. So aim for twelve out of fifteen today.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir dars testining o‘tish chegarasi oltmish foiz. Sertifikat kurs oxirida, C2 yakuniy imtihonidan keyin beriladi, u yerda sakson foiz kerak. Shuning uchun bugun o‘n beshdan o‘n ikkini maqsad qiling.

scenes.title: Imtihon strategiyasi
board: 1 Read the question before the text
2 Underline: not, except, most likely, attitude
3 Stuck? Mark it, move on, come back
scenes.say_native: Oldingi darslarda vaqtni boshqarishni o‘rgangan edik. Birinchi: savolni matndan oldin o‘qing. Ikkinchi: “not”, “except”, “most likely”, “attitude” kabi kalit so‘zlarning tagiga chizing, C1 da ballning ko‘pi aynan shu so‘zlarda yo‘qoladi. Uchinchi: qiyin savolga yopishib qolmang, belgilab, keyin qayting. To‘rtinchi: oxirgi uch daqiqani tekshirishga qoldiring.
scenes.say: Read the question first, and underline the words that change everything: not, except, most likely. If an item resists, mark it and move on.
scenes.say_uz: Avval savolni o‘qing va hammasini o‘zgartiradigan so‘zlarning tagiga chizing: not, except, most likely. Savol qiyin bo‘lsa, belgilab keyingisiga o‘ting.

scenes.title: Grammatika: inversiya
board: Never have I… · Rarely do we… · Not only did she…
No sooner had… than · Hardly had… when
Only then did… · Little did he know…

examples.t: Never have I seen such a well-organised event.
examples.uz: Bunchalik yaxshi tashkil etilgan tadbirni hech qachon ko‘rmaganman.

examples.t: No sooner had we sat down than the fire alarm went off.
examples.uz: O‘tirishimiz bilan yong‘in signali chalindi.

examples.t: Little did he know that the email had been forwarded.
examples.uz: Xat boshqalarga yuborilganini u bilmas edi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi ustun inversiya. Gap “never”, “rarely”, “not only”, “no sooner”, “hardly”, “only then”, “little” kabi so‘z bilan boshlansa, savoldagidek yordamchi fe’l egadan oldin keladi. Yordamchi fe’l bo‘lmasa, “do”, “does”, “did” qo‘shiladi. O‘zbek tilida so‘z tartibi bunday o‘zgarmaydi, urg‘uni “hatto”, “aslo” kabi so‘zlar beradi. Inglizchada esa inversiya rasmiy, kuchli uslub belgisi.
scenes.say: When a sentence opens with a negative or limiting adverbial, the auxiliary comes before the subject, just as in a question. Never have I seen anything like it.
scenes.say_uz: Gap inkor yoki cheklovchi ravish bilan boshlansa, yordamchi fe’l xuddi savoldagidek egadan oldin keladi. Bunga o‘xshash narsani hech ko‘rmaganman.

scenes.title: Inversiyadagi xatolar
board: ✗ Never I have seen…  ✓ Never have I seen…
✗ No sooner had I arrived when…  ✓ …than…
✗ Not only she speaks…  ✓ Not only does she speak…
scenes.say_native: Uch xil xato ko‘p uchraydi. Birinchisi, inversiyani unutish: “Never I have seen” emas, “Never have I seen”. Ikkinchisi, juftlarni aralashtirish: “no sooner” doim “than” bilan, “hardly” va “scarcely” esa “when” bilan keladi. Eslab qolish oson: “sooner” qiyosiy shakl, qiyosdan keyin esa “than” keladi. Uchinchisi, “not only” dan keyin “does” yoki “did” ni tushirib qoldirish.
scenes.say: No sooner goes with than, because sooner is a comparative. Hardly and scarcely go with when. And after not only, keep the auxiliary: not only does she speak French.
scenes.say_uz: No sooner than bilan keladi, chunki sooner qiyosiy shakl. Hardly va scarcely when bilan keladi. Not only dan keyin yordamchi fe’lni saqlang: u nafaqat fransuzcha gapiradi.

scenes.title: Ajratilgan gaplar
board: What + clause + be: What we need is time.
It + be + X + who/that: It was Aziz who solved it.

examples.t: What surprised me most was the price.
examples.uz: Meni eng ko‘p hayratga solgani narx bo‘ldi.

examples.t: It was only in 2020 that the law was changed.
examples.uz: Qonun faqat 2020-yilda o‘zgartirildi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi urg‘u vositasi ajratilgan gaplar. “What surprised me most was the price” gapida diqqat oxiriga, “the price” ga tushadi. “It was Aziz who solved it” esa “boshqa birov emas, aynan Aziz” degani. O‘zbek tilida buni “aynan” yoki “-gina” bilan qilamiz: “Muammoni aynan Aziz hal qildi”. Inglizchada “aynan” ga to‘liq teng so‘z yo‘q, shuning uchun mana shu qolip ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Cleft sentences split one idea into two parts to put the spotlight where you want it. It was the manager, not the team, who made the final decision.
scenes.say_uz: Ajratilgan gaplar bitta fikrni ikki qismga bo‘lib, diqqatni kerakli joyga qaratadi. Yakuniy qarorni jamoa emas, aynan menejer qabul qilgan.

scenes.title: Modal fe’llar: o‘tmish haqida xulosa

examples.t: She must have left already; her coat's gone.
examples.uz: U ketib qolgan bo‘lsa kerak, paltosi yo‘q.

examples.t: He can't have read the report; he didn't know the figures.
examples.uz: U hisobotni o‘qigan bo‘lishi mumkin emas, raqamlarni bilmadi.

examples.t: You should have told me earlier.
examples.uz: Menga oldinroq aytishingiz kerak edi.

scenes.say_native: O‘tmish haqida xulosa uchun modal fe’l, “have” va uchinchi shakl ishlatiladi. “Must have” — ishonchim komil, “can’t have” — bo‘lishi mumkin emas, “might have” — ehtimol. “Should have” esa xulosa emas, afsus yoki tanqid. O‘zbek tilida bularning ko‘pini “-gan bo‘lsa kerak”, “-gan bo‘lishi mumkin” deymiz, shuning uchun inglizchada ishonch darajasini aniq tanlash kerak.
scenes.say: Modal plus have plus past participle lets you speculate about the past. Must have for near certainty, might have for a possibility, can't have when you're sure it didn't happen.
scenes.say_uz: Modal, have va uchinchi shakl o‘tmish haqida taxmin qilish imkonini beradi. Must have deyarli aniq, might have ehtimol, can’t have esa bo‘lmaganiga ishonchingiz komil bo‘lganda.

scenes.title: Modal xatolari
board: ✗ He mustn't have known.  ✓ He can't have known.
needn't have gone = went, but it was unnecessary
didn't need to go = (usually) didn't go

examples.t: I needn't have brought an umbrella. It didn't rain.
examples.uz: Soyabon olib kelishim shart emas ekan. Yomg‘ir yog‘madi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato: salbiy xulosada “mustn’t have” deyish. Britaniya ingliz tilida buning uchun “can’t have” yoki “couldn’t have” ishlatiladi, “mustn’t” esa taqiqni bildiradi. Amerika og‘zaki nutqida “must not have” uchraydi, lekin imtihonda “can’t have” xavfsiz. Ikkinchi nozik farq: “I needn’t have gone” — bordim, lekin keraksiz edi. “I didn’t need to go” esa odatda bormaganingizni bildiradi.
scenes.say: For negative deduction, say can't have, not mustn't have. And remember: I needn't have cooked means I cooked, but it was unnecessary.
scenes.say_uz: Salbiy xulosa uchun mustn’t have emas, can’t have deng. Esda tuting: I needn’t have cooked — pishirdim, lekin keraksiz edi.

scenes.title: Qisqartirilgan ergash gaplar
board: The people living nearby… (= who live)
The figures published last week… (= which were published)

examples.t: Having checked the data twice, we submitted the article.
examples.uz: Ma’lumotlarni ikki marta tekshirib bo‘lgach, maqolani topshirdik.

examples.t: Residents living near the airport have complained.
examples.uz: Aeroport yaqinida yashovchi aholi shikoyat qildi.

scenes.say_native: C1 uslubining yana bir belgisi qisqartirilgan ergash gaplar. “Who live” o‘rniga “living”, “which were published” o‘rniga “published”, “after she had finished” o‘rniga “having finished”. Bu yerda o‘zbek tili sizga yordam beradi: biz ham “yashovchi”, “e’lon qilingan”, “tugatib bo‘lgach” kabi shakllarni tabiiy ishlatamiz. Faqat bitta qoidani buzmang, uni hozir ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Participle clauses make writing tighter. Having finished the report, she went home. The figures published last week were misleading.
scenes.say_uz: Sifatdoshli bo‘laklar yozuvni ixchamroq qiladi. Hisobotni tugatgach, u uyga ketdi. O‘tgan hafta e’lon qilingan raqamlar chalg‘ituvchi edi.

scenes.title: Osilib qolgan sifatdosh
board: ✓ Walking home, I got caught in the rain.
Subject of the participle = subject of the main clause
scenes.say_native: Qoida: sifatdosh bo‘lakning egasi bosh gapning egasi bilan bir xil bo‘lishi shart. “Walking home, the rain started” gapida uyga yomg‘ir ketayotgandek chiqadi. To‘g‘risi: “Walking home, I got caught in the rain”. O‘zbek tilida “Uyga ketayotib, yomg‘ir yog‘di” deyish mumkin, shuning uchun bu xato aynan o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilarda ko‘p uchraydi.
scenes.say: Walking home, the rain started suggests that the rain was walking home. Make the person doing the action the subject.
scenes.say_uz: Walking home, the rain started gapi yomg‘ir uyga ketayotgandek ma’no beradi. Harakatni bajaruvchini ega qiling.

scenes.title: Vaqtli mashq: grammatika
board: 1) Rarely ___ such a clear explanation. (I / hear)
2) What made it work ___ the team's commitment.
3) The lights are off. They ___ (go) out.
4) It didn't rain. I ___ (take) an umbrella.
5) ___ (complete) the report, she sent it off.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi vaqtli topshiriq. Beshta gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchisida inversiya, ikkinchisida ajratilgan gapning fe’li, uchinchisida o‘tmish haqida xulosa kerak. To‘rtinchisida soyabonni olgansiz, lekin u keraksiz bo‘lib chiqdi. Beshinchisida ish tugaganini qisqartirilgan bo‘lak bilan bildiring. Yigirma soniya.
scenes.say: Complete the five sentences. In number four, you did take the umbrella. Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Beshta gapni to‘ldiring. To‘rtinchisida soyabonni olgansiz. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: grammatika
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “Rarely have I heard”, chunki “rarely” inversiya talab qiladi. Ikkinchi: “was”, “what” bilan boshlangan ajratilgan gap birlikda turadi. Uchinchi: “must have gone”, chiroqlar o‘chgan, demak deyarli aniq. To‘rtinchi: “needn’t have taken”, chunki soyabonni olgansiz. Beshinchi: “Having completed”. Beshtadan to‘rttasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, grammatikangiz tayyor.
scenes.say: Rarely have I heard. Was. Must have gone. Needn't have taken. Having completed.
scenes.say_uz: Rarely have I heard. Was. Must have gone. Needn’t have taken. Having completed.

scenes.title: Akademik lug‘at: so‘z oilalari

examples.t: The analysis was carried out by an independent team.
examples.uz: Tahlil mustaqil jamoa tomonidan o‘tkazildi.

examples.t: Prices rose significantly in the second quarter.
examples.uz: Ikkinchi chorakda narxlar sezilarli oshdi.

scenes.say_native: Akademik so‘zni bitta emas, butun oilasi bilan o‘rganing: fe’l, ot, sifat va ravish. Imtihonda ko‘pincha so‘zning shakli so‘raladi: “The ___ was carried out” gapiga “analyse” emas, “analysis” kerak. Britaniya imlosida “analyse”, Amerikada “analyze” deb yoziladi. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri, faqat bitta matnda bitta imloni saqlang.
scenes.say: Learn academic words as families. Analyse, analysis, analytical, analytically. The British spelling has an s; Americans use a z. Just be consistent.
scenes.say_uz: Akademik so‘zlarni oila sifatida o‘rganing. Analyse, analysis, analytical, analytically. Britaniya imlosida s, amerikaliklarda z. Faqat izchil bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Akademik hamrohlar
board: draw a conclusion · pose a threat
raise concerns · play a key role

examples.t: The new virus poses a serious threat to public health.
examples.uz: Yangi virus jamoat salomatligiga jiddiy xavf tug‘diradi.

examples.t: The findings have raised concerns among teachers.
examples.uz: Natijalar o‘qituvchilar orasida xavotir uyg‘otdi.

scenes.say_native: C1 da so‘zning o‘zi yetmaydi, uning hamrohini ham bilish kerak. Tadqiqot “conduct” qilinadi, xulosa “draw” qilinadi, xavf “pose” qilinadi, xavotir “raise” qilinadi. O‘zbekchada “xavf tug‘dirmoq”, “xulosa chiqarmoq” deymiz, lekin so‘zma-so‘z o‘girib bo‘lmaydi: “give birth to a threat” yoki “take out a conclusion” degan birikmalar yo‘q.
scenes.say: Examiners reward strong collocations. You conduct research, draw conclusions, pose a threat and raise concerns.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihonchilar kuchli birikmalarni qadrlaydi. Tadqiqot o‘tkaziladi, xulosa chiqariladi, xavf tug‘diriladi, xavotir uyg‘otiladi.

scenes.title: Hamroh so‘z xatolari
board: ✗ do a mistake  ✓ make a mistake
scenes.say_native: Bular C1 da ham qotib qolgan xatolar. “Make research” emas, “do” yoki “conduct research”. “Do a mistake” emas, “make a mistake”. “Give attention” emas, “pay attention”. “Big rain” emas, “heavy rain”, chunki “katta yomg‘ir” so‘zma-so‘z tarjima. Rus tili ham ta’sir qiladi: “сделать ошибку” uchun “make a mistake” to‘g‘ri chiqadi, lekin “сделать исследование” dan kelgan “make research” xato.
scenes.say: Not make research, but do or conduct research. Not do a mistake, but make one. You pay attention, and rain is heavy, not big.
scenes.say_uz: Make research emas, do yoki conduct research. Do a mistake emas, make a mistake. Pay attention deyiladi, yomg‘ir esa big emas, heavy.

scenes.title: Rasmiy uslub va ehtiyotkor ifoda
board: get → obtain · show → demonstrate · go up → rise
They introduced a tax, so sales fell. → The introduction of the tax led to a fall in sales.
Hedging: tends to · arguably · the evidence suggests

examples.t: The evidence suggests that the policy may have had little effect.
examples.uz: Dalillar siyosat deyarli ta’sir qilmagan bo‘lishi mumkinligini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Akademik uslubning uch quroli bor. Rasmiy sinonim: “get” o‘rniga “obtain”, “show” o‘rniga “demonstrate”. Nominalizatsiya, ya’ni fe’lni otga aylantirish: “The introduction of the tax led to a fall in sales”. Va ehtiyotkor ifoda: “tends to”, “arguably”, “the evidence suggests”. O‘zbekchada ham “aftidan”, “ehtimol” deymiz. Lekin oshirib yubormang, aks holda matn og‘irlashadi.
scenes.say: Academic style relies on formal verbs, nominalisation and careful hedging. Rather than this proves it, write the evidence suggests it may be so.
scenes.say_uz: Akademik uslub rasmiy fe’llar, nominalizatsiya va ehtiyotkor ifodaga tayanadi. Bu buni isbotlaydi o‘rniga, dalillar shunday bo‘lishi mumkinligini ko‘rsatadi, deb yozing.

scenes.title: Vaqtli mashq: lug‘at
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi vaqtli topshiriq. Har bir qatorda ikkita variant bor, to‘g‘ri hamrohni tanlang. To‘rtinchi qatorga ehtiyot bo‘ling: ikki fe’l bir-biriga juda o‘xshaydi, lekin biri to‘ldiruvchi oladi, ikkinchisi olmaydi. Beshinchisida esa o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima tuzog‘i bor. O‘n besh soniya.
scenes.say: Choose the correct collocation in each line. Fifteen seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir qatorda to‘g‘ri birikmani tanlang. O‘n besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: lug‘at
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “conduct research”, “draw a conclusion”, “pose a threat”, “raise concerns”, “widespread support”. To‘rtinchisi haqida: “raise” o‘timli fe’l, ya’ni nimanidir ko‘taradi. “Rise” esa o‘zi ko‘tariladi: “Prices rose”. Shakllarini ham eslang: “raise, raised, raised”, lekin “rise, rose, risen”. “Big support” esa o‘zbekcha “katta qo‘llab-quvvatlash” dan kelgan xato.
scenes.say: Conduct, draw, pose, raise and widespread. You raise something, but prices rise on their own.
scenes.say_uz: Conduct, draw, pose, raise va widespread. Nimanidir raise qilasiz, narxlar esa o‘zi rise bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: O‘qish: muallif munosabati
board: Attitude markers: at best · quietly admit · owe us

examples.t: The results are, at best, inconclusive.
examples.uz: Natijalar, eng yaxshi holatda ham, aniq xulosa bermaydi.

scenes.say_native: C1 o‘qish bo‘limida savollar ko‘pincha faktni emas, muallif munosabatini so‘raydi. Munosabat bitta iborada yashiringan bo‘ladi: “at best” — muallif shubhada, “quietly admit” — odamlar ochiq aytmaydi. Javob variantida matndagi so‘z aynan takrorlansa, ehtiyot bo‘ling, ko‘pincha bu tuzoq. To‘g‘ri javob odatda matnni boshqa so‘zlar bilan ifodalaydi.
scenes.say: Many C1 reading questions test attitude and implication. Look for evaluative language, and be suspicious of an option that simply repeats words from the text.
scenes.say_uz: C1 o‘qishida ko‘p savollar munosabat va yashirin ma’noni tekshiradi. Baholovchi so‘zlarni qidiring va matn so‘zlarini shunchaki takrorlagan variantga shubha bilan qarang.

scenes.title: O‘qish matni: masofadan ishlash
scenes.say_native: Qisqa fikr maqolasini tinglang va kuzatib boring. Mavzu masofadan ishlash. Muallif o‘z munosabatini qanday so‘zlar orqali bildirayotganiga e’tibor bering. “Murky” so‘zi loyqa, tushunarsiz degani, “evangelist” esa biror g‘oyani qizg‘in targ‘ib qiluvchi kishi. Keyin to‘rtta savol beriladi.
scenes.say: Remote work was hailed as a revolution. Yet, three years on, the picture is far murkier. Productivity figures are, at best, inconclusive, and many managers quietly admit that they miss the corridor conversations where ideas used to be born. None of this means we should march everyone back to the office. It does mean, however, that the evangelists owe us a little more humility.
scenes.say_uz: Masofadan ishlash inqilob deb olqishlangan edi. Biroq uch yil o‘tib, manzara ancha noaniq. Unumdorlik ko‘rsatkichlari, eng yaxshi holatda ham, aniq xulosa bermaydi, ko‘plab rahbarlar esa g‘oyalar tug‘iladigan yo‘lakdagi suhbatlarni sog‘inishlarini ichida tan olishadi. Bu hammani ofisga qaytarish kerak degani emas. Lekin bu uning qizg‘in targ‘ibotchilari biroz kamtarroq bo‘lishi kerakligini anglatadi.

scenes.title: O‘qish savollari
board: 1) What is the writer's attitude to the 'evangelists'?
2) Does the writer want everyone back in the office?
4) Which phrase adds the writer's own evaluation to the figures?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi: muallif masofadan ishlashning qizg‘in tarafdorlariga qanday munosabatda. Ikkinchi: muallif hammani ofisga qaytarishni xohlaydimi. Uchinchi: “the picture is far murkier” nimani anglatadi. To‘rtinchi: unumdorlik raqamlari haqidagi gapda qaysi ibora muallifning shaxsiy bahosini qo‘shadi. O‘n besh soniya.
scenes.say: Four questions. Answer them in writing. Fifteen seconds.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savol. Javoblarni yozing. O‘n besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: o‘qish
board: 1) Mildly critical: they should be more modest
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: muallif ularni biroz tanqid qiladi, kamtarroq bo‘lishlari kerak deydi, lekin butunlay rad etmaydi. Ikkinchi: yo‘q, “None of this means we should march everyone back” gapi buni aniq aytadi. Uchinchi: “murkier” — ancha noaniq. To‘rtinchi: “at best”, ya’ni “eng yaxshi holatda ham”. Bu ibora quruq faktga muallifning shubhasini qo‘shadi. C1 savollarining asosi mana shu nozik farqlar.
scenes.say: Mildly critical: the writer wants more humility, not total rejection. No. Much less clear. And at best, which adds the writer's scepticism.
scenes.say_uz: Biroz tanqidiy: muallif butunlay rad etmaydi, faqat kamtarlik so‘raydi. Yo‘q. Ancha noaniq. Va at best, u muallifning shubhasini qo‘shadi.

scenes.title: Birinchi tinglash: ish yig‘ilishi
board: Dilnoza and Mark discuss a product launch
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Dilnoza va Mark yangi mahsulotni chiqarish sanasini muhokama qilmoqda. Mark to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri “yo‘q” demaydi, shuning uchun uning nima nazarda tutayotganini so‘zlar ortidan eshiting. Oxiridagi “pencil in” iborasiga ham e’tibor bering, savollarda u kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Dilnoza: So, are we agreed on launching in March? Mark: Well, March is certainly ambitious. Dilnoza: Ambitious meaning impossible? Mark: Not impossible. But if testing runs over, we'd be cutting it very fine. I'd feel more comfortable with April, provided marketing can live with that. Dilnoza: Fair enough. Let's pencil in April and revisit it next week.
scenes.say_uz: Dilnoza: Xo‘sh, martda chiqarishga kelishdikmi? Mark: Endi, mart, albatta, juda dadil reja. Dilnoza: Dadil, ya’ni imkonsizmi? Mark: Imkonsiz emas. Lekin sinov cho‘zilsa, vaqtimiz juda tig‘iz bo‘ladi. Agar marketing bunga rozi bo‘lsa, aprel menga ma’qulroq. Dilnoza: Mayli. Aprelni taxminan belgilab qo‘yamiz va kelasi hafta yana ko‘rib chiqamiz.

scenes.title: Birinchi tinglash savollari
board: 1) What does Mark really think of March?
2) On what condition does he prefer April?
3) Is the April date final? Which phrase tells you?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Mark mart oyi haqida aslida nima deb o‘ylaydi. Ikkinchi: u aprelni qanday shart bilan taklif qiladi. Uchinchi: aprel sanasi qat’iymi va buni qaysi ibora ko‘rsatadi. Javoblarni qisqa yozing, to‘liq gap shart emas. O‘n ikki soniya.
scenes.say: Three questions about the meeting. Twelve seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Yig‘ilish haqida uchta savol. O‘n ikki soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: birinchi tinglash
board: 1) He thinks it's risky, probably too early
2) provided marketing can live with it
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: Mark martni xavfli, ehtimol juda erta deb hisoblaydi. “Ambitious” bu yerda muloyim tanqid, “cutting it very fine” esa vaqt juda tig‘iz degani. Ikkinchi: shart “provided marketing can live with that”, ya’ni marketing rozi bo‘lsa. Uchinchi: yo‘q, sana qat’iy emas. “Pencil in” qalam bilan yozish, ya’ni keyin o‘zgartirish mumkin bo‘lgan vaqtinchalik kelishuv.
scenes.say: Ambitious is a polite way of saying risky. The condition is that marketing can live with April. And to pencil something in means to arrange it provisionally.
scenes.say_uz: Ambitious xavfli deyishning muloyim usuli. Shart: marketing aprelga rozi bo‘lsa. Pencil in esa vaqtincha kelishib qo‘yish degani.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi tinglash: ma’ruza parchasi
board: A lecture on cities and heat
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash ma’ruzadan parcha, mavzu shaharlardagi issiqlik. Ma’ruzalarda eng muhim fikr ko‘pincha “but”, “the crucial point is” kabi signal so‘zlardan keyin keladi. O‘sha joyni ayniqsa diqqat bilan tinglang. “Culprit” so‘zi aybdor degani. Raqam va sabablarni ham eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Good morning. Today's topic is urban heat. Cities can be several degrees warmer than the surrounding countryside, a phenomenon known as the urban heat island effect. The main culprits are dark surfaces such as asphalt, which absorb heat during the day and release it at night. Now, the obvious solution, planting trees, does help. But, and this is the crucial point, it only works if the trees are watered and maintained.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong. Bugungi mavzu shahar issiqligi. Shaharlar atrofdagi qishloq joylardan bir necha daraja issiqroq bo‘lishi mumkin, bu hodisa shahar issiqlik oroli effekti deb ataladi. Asosiy aybdorlar asfalt kabi qora yuzalar, ular kunduzi issiqlikni yutib, kechasi chiqaradi. Aniq yechim, ya’ni daraxt ekish, albatta yordam beradi. Lekin, eng muhimi shuki, bu faqat daraxtlar sug‘orilib, parvarish qilinsa ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi tinglash savollari
board: 2) Why are dark surfaces a problem?
3) What is the speaker's crucial point?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: hodisa qanday ataladi. Ikkinchi: qora yuzalar nega muammo. Uchinchi: ma’ruzachining eng muhim fikri nima. Uchinchi savolga javob berganda signal so‘zdan keyingi gapni eslang, chunki javob aynan o‘sha yerda edi. O‘n ikki soniya.
scenes.say: Three questions about the lecture. Twelve seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’ruza haqida uchta savol. O‘n ikki soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ikkinchi tinglash
board: 2) they absorb heat by day and release it at night
3) trees help only if watered and maintained
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “the urban heat island effect”, shahar issiqlik oroli effekti. Ikkinchi: qora yuzalar kunduzi issiqlikni yutadi va kechasi chiqaradi. Uchinchi: daraxt ekish faqat ular sug‘orilib, parvarish qilinsagina foyda beradi. Ko‘p o‘quvchi shunchaki “planting trees” deb yozadi va ballni yo‘qotadi, chunki asosiy fikr daraxtning o‘zida emas, undan keyingi shartda edi.
scenes.say: The urban heat island effect. Dark surfaces absorb heat by day and release it at night. And trees help only if they're watered and maintained.
scenes.say_uz: Shahar issiqlik oroli effekti. Qora yuzalar kunduzi issiqlikni yutib, kechasi chiqaradi. Daraxtlar esa faqat sug‘orilib, parvarish qilinsa yordam beradi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar va zid urg‘u
board: Contrastive stress: I didn't say SHE took it.

examples.t: You should've asked me first.
examples.uz: Avval mendan so‘rashingiz kerak edi.

scenes.say_native: Tinglashda modal fe’llar ko‘pincha eshitilmay qoladi, chunki “have” kuchsiz shaklda, deyarli “əv” bo‘lib aytiladi: “must’ve”, “should’ve”. Shu sababli ba’zan “should of” deb yozib yuborishadi, bu xato. Ikkinchi nuqta zid urg‘u: inglizchada qaysi so‘zga urg‘u bersangiz, ma’no o‘sha so‘zga qarab o‘zgaradi. O‘zbek tilida biz buni ko‘proq “-ku”, “aynan” bilan qilamiz.
scenes.say: In fast speech, have becomes a weak form: must've, should've. Never write should of. And by stressing one word, you can change the whole message.
scenes.say_uz: Tez nutqda have kuchsiz shaklga o‘tadi: must’ve, should’ve. Hech qachon should of deb yozmang. Bitta so‘zga urg‘u berib, butun ma’noni o‘zgartirish mumkin.

scenes.title: Mashq: urg‘u ma’noni o‘zgartiradi
board: a) I didn't say SHE took it.
b) I didn't SAY she took it.
c) I didn't say she took IT.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni ovoz chiqarib, bosh harf bilan yozilgan so‘zga urg‘u berib ayting. Keyin har biri nimani nazarda tutishini o‘ylang: a variantda gap kim haqida, b variantda qanday aytilgani haqida, c variantda nima olingani haqida. Ohangni bo‘rttirib ayting. O‘n besh soniya.
scenes.say: Say each sentence aloud, stressing the word in capitals, and decide what it implies.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni bosh harfdagi so‘zga urg‘u berib ayting va nimani nazarda tutishini aniqlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: urg‘u
board: b) I implied it, but didn't say it
scenes.say_native: a variant: “u emas, boshqa birov oldi”. b variant: “aytmadim, lekin shama qildim”. c variant: “u buni emas, boshqa narsani oldi”. Tinglash bo‘limida bunday urg‘u ko‘pincha javobning kaliti bo‘ladi: suhbatdosh ohangni ko‘tarib bitta so‘zni ajratsa, o‘sha so‘z javobda bo‘lishi ehtimoli yuqori.
scenes.say: Someone else took it. I implied it without saying it. She took something else. In listening tests, a stressed word often points to the answer.
scenes.say_uz: Boshqa birov oldi. Aytmadim, shama qildim. U boshqa narsani oldi. Tinglash testida urg‘uli so‘z ko‘pincha javobga ishora qiladi.

scenes.title: Yozish: baholash mezonlari
scenes.say_native: IELTS inshosi to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha baholanadi, boshqa C1 imtihonlarida ham mantiq shunga yaqin. Birinchisi, topshiriqqa javob: savolning hamma qismiga javob berdingizmi, pozitsiyangiz aniqmi. Ikkinchisi, izchillik va bog‘lanish. Uchinchisi, lug‘at boyligi. To‘rtinchisi, grammatika xilma-xilligi va to‘g‘riligi. Ko‘pchilik faqat lug‘atga e’tibor berib, birinchi mezonda ball yo‘qotadi.
scenes.say: Examiners assess how fully you answer the task, how well your ideas are organised, and the range and accuracy of your vocabulary and grammar. A clear position matters as much as clever words.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihonchilar topshiriqqa qanchalik to‘liq javob berganingizni, fikrlar qanchalik tartibli ekanini, lug‘at va grammatikangizning boyligi va to‘g‘riligini baholaydi. Aniq pozitsiya chiroyli so‘zlar kabi muhim.

scenes.title: Yozuvdagi uslub xatolari
board: ✗ A lot of people think that…  ✓ It is widely believed that…
✗ Kids don't wanna study.  ✓ Children are often reluctant to study.
✗ A new argument in the conclusion
scenes.say_native: Inshoda eng ko‘p uchraydigan muammo uslubning sirpanib ketishi. “Kids”, “wanna”, “a lot of”, “stuff” og‘zaki nutq uchun yaxshi, lekin rasmiy inshoda ball pasaytiradi. Akademik inshoda “don’t”, “can’t” kabi qisqartmalar ham odatda to‘liq yoziladi. Yana bir xato: xulosada yangi dalil keltirish. Xulosa pozitsiyani boshqa so‘zlar bilan mustahkamlashi kerak, xolos.
scenes.say: Replace kids with children and a lot of with many, avoid contractions, and never introduce a new argument in your conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Kids o‘rniga children, a lot of o‘rniga many yozing, qisqartmalardan qoching va xulosada hech qachon yangi dalil keltirmang.

scenes.title: Vaqtli yozma topshiriq: kirish
board: Task: Some people believe university education should be free for everyone. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
1 paraphrase the issue  2 state your position
scenes.say_native: Endi yozish. Mavzu: ba’zilar universitet ta’limi hamma uchun bepul bo‘lishi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Ikki gapli kirish yozing: birinchi gapda masalani o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan ifodalang, ikkinchisida pozitsiyangizni ayting. Yigirma soniya kamlik qilsa, shu yerda to‘xtatib, bemalol yozing, bu topshiriq taxminan uch daqiqa oladi.
scenes.say: Write a two-sentence introduction: paraphrase the question, then state your position. Pause here if you need more time.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki gapli kirish yozing: savolni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan ifodalang, so‘ng pozitsiyangizni ayting. Ko‘proq vaqt kerak bo‘lsa, shu yerda to‘xtating.

scenes.title: Namuna kirish
board: It is often argued that higher education should be funded entirely by the state,
while others maintain that students should share the cost.
In my view, … it should be guaranteed for students from low-income families.
scenes.say_native: Namunaga qarang. “University education should be free” iborasi “higher education should be funded entirely by the state” bilan almashtirildi, ya’ni so‘zlar ko‘chirilmadi. Ikkala qarash bitta gapda berildi. Ikkinchi gapda pozitsiya aniq, lekin nozik: hamma uchun emas, kam ta’minlangan oilalar talabalari uchun. Mana shunday ehtiyotkor pozitsiya C1 belgisi.
scenes.say: It is often argued that higher education should be funded entirely by the state, while others maintain that students should share the cost. In my view, although free tuition for every course may be unrealistic, it should be guaranteed for students from low-income families.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘pincha oliy ta’lim to‘liq davlat tomonidan moliyalashtirilishi kerak deb ta’kidlanadi, boshqalar esa talabalar xarajatning bir qismini to‘lashi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Menimcha, har bir yo‘nalish uchun bepul o‘qish real bo‘lmasa-da, kam ta’minlangan oilalar talabalari uchun u kafolatlanishi kerak.

scenes.title: Gapirish: mezon va strategiya

examples.t: Let me put that another way.
examples.uz: Buni boshqacha aytay.

examples.t: That's not to say that talent is irrelevant.
examples.uz: Bu iste’dod ahamiyatsiz degani emas.

scenes.say_native: Gapirishda mezonlar: ravonlik va izchillik, lug‘at, grammatika va talaffuz. Javobni to‘rt qadamda quring: aniq javob, sabab, misol va cheklov, masalan “that’s not to say that…”. Xato qilsangiz, tabiiy tuzating: “Let me put that another way”. Yod olingan javobdan va bir daqiqada beshta idiomadan qoching: imtihonchi buni darhol sezadi.
scenes.say: Build each answer in four moves: answer, reason, example, qualification. If you slip, correct yourself smoothly. Self-correction shows control, not weakness.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir javobni to‘rt qadamda quring: javob, sabab, misol, cheklov. Adashsangiz, silliq tuzating. O‘zini tuzatish zaiflikni emas, nazoratni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Gapirish topshirig‘i
board: Question: Is talent more important than hard work?
scenes.say_native: Savol: iste’dod mehnatdan muhimroqmi? Yigirma soniya tayyorlaning, keyin taxminan bir daqiqa ovoz chiqarib javob bering. To‘rt qadamni eslang: javob, sabab, misol va cheklov. Bugun takrorlagan bitta ajratilgan gap yoki inversiyani ishlatib ko‘ring, masalan “What really matters is…”.
scenes.say: Is talent more important than hard work? Plan for twenty seconds, then speak for about a minute.
scenes.say_uz: Iste’dod mehnatdan muhimroqmi? Yigirma soniya rejalang, keyin taxminan bir daqiqa gapiring.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: What really matters, I'd argue, is…
That's not to say that talent is irrelevant.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javobni tinglang va tuzilishiga e’tibor bering: avval ajratilgan gap bilan aniq pozitsiya, keyin sabab, so‘ng aniq misol, oxirida “that’s not to say” bilan cheklov. Javobingizni shu bilan solishtiring: to‘rt qadam bormi, kamida bitta C1 tuzilmasi bormi, to‘xtab qolmadingizmi.
scenes.say: What really matters, I'd argue, is hard work. Talent gives you a head start, but it rarely keeps you ahead. Take my cousin, for instance: she wasn't the most gifted pianist in her class, but she practised every single day, and she's now the only one still playing professionally. That's not to say talent is irrelevant; it simply isn't enough on its own.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, eng muhimi mehnat. Iste’dod oldinda boshlash imkonini beradi, lekin kamdan kam hollarda oldinda ushlab turadi. Masalan, amakivachcham sinfidagi eng iste’dodli pianinochi emasdi, lekin har kuni mashq qilardi va hozir ulardan faqat u professional chalmoqda. Bu iste’dod ahamiyatsiz degani emas, shunchaki uning o‘zi yetarli emas.

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
board: 1) I am agree with this opinion.
4) Despite of the rain, we continued.
scenes.say_native: Oxirgi vaqtli topshiriq: o‘zini tekshirish. Yozma ishni topshirishdan oldin artikl, old ko‘makchi, moslashuv va uslubni tekshirish kerak. Beshta gapning har birida bitta xato bor, ular o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilarda C1 da ham saqlanib qoladigan xatolar. Har birini tuzating. O‘n besh soniya.
scenes.say: Each sentence contains one error. Find it and correct it. Fifteen seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapda bitta xato bor. Uni toping va tuzating. O‘n besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: xatolar
board: 3) She explained the problem to me.
4) Despite the rain / In spite of the rain
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “agree” fe’l, unga “am” kerak emas, bu o‘zbekcha “roziman” va ruscha “я согласен” ta’siri. Ikkinchi: “information” sanalmaydi, demak “was”. Uchinchi: “explain” dan keyin “to me” keladi. To‘rtinchi: “despite” dan keyin “of” yo‘q, “in spite of” da esa bor. Beshinchi: “discuss” dan keyin “about” kerak emas, garchi “a discussion about” to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa ham.
scenes.say: I agree. The information was. She explained the problem to me. Despite the rain. We discussed the budget, with no about.
scenes.say_uz: I agree. The information was. She explained the problem to me. Despite the rain. We discussed the budget, about siz.

scenes.title: C1 darajasi: xulosa
board: Grammar: inversion · clefts · past modals · participle clauses
Skills: attitude · implication · task response · flexibility
scenes.say_native: Butun C1 darajasini jamlaylik. Grammatikada inversiya, ajratilgan gaplar, o‘tmish modallari va qisqartirilgan ergash gaplarni o‘zlashtirdingiz. Lug‘atda so‘z oilalari, akademik hamrohlar va ehtiyotkor ifoda. Ko‘nikmalarda muallif munosabatini o‘qish, yashirin ma’noni eshitish, topshiriqqa to‘liq javob berish va moslashuvchan gapirish. Bu katta yo‘l, siz uni bosib o‘tdingiz.
scenes.say: You can now use inversion and clefts for emphasis, speculate precisely about the past, write with strong collocations and careful hedging, and read and listen for attitude, not just facts.
scenes.say_uz: Endi siz urg‘u uchun inversiya va ajratilgan gaplarni ishlatasiz, o‘tmish haqida aniq taxmin qilasiz, kuchli birikmalar va ehtiyotkor ifoda bilan yozasiz, faqat faktni emas, munosabatni ham o‘qib, eshitasiz.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: complete the C1 final exam (15 questions)
Then: write down every mistake with a reason
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: C1 yakuniy imtihon testini to‘liq topshiring. O‘tish uchun to‘qqiz ball yetadi, lekin muvaffaqiyat mezoni o‘n beshtadan kamida o‘n ikkita to‘g‘ri javob. Test tugagach, har bir xatoni xatolar daftaringizga yozing va nega xato bo‘lganini bir gap bilan izohlang. Tabriklayman, C1 darajasini yakunladingiz! Keyingi darsda C1 dan C2 ga, ya’ni ona tiliga yaqin darajaga yo‘lni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Complete the C1 final exam and aim for at least twelve out of fifteen. Congratulations on finishing C1. Next time we begin the road to C2.
scenes.say_uz: C1 yakuniy imtihonini topshiring va kamida o‘n beshdan o‘n ikki ball oling. C1 ni yakunlaganingiz bilan tabriklayman. Keyingi darsda C2 sari yo‘lni boshlaymiz.

homework_uz: C1 yakuniy imtihon testini (15 savol) to‘liq topshiring. Har bir xatoni xatolar daftaringizga yozing va nega xato bo‘lganini bir gap bilan izohlang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘n beshtadan kamida 12 ta to‘g‘ri javob (o‘tish chegarasi 9 ta).

quiz.q: Choose the correct option: 'Never ___ such a convincing argument.'
quiz.why_uz: Never bilan boshlangan gapda inversiya kerak: yordamchi fe’l egadan oldin keladi — have I heard.

quiz.q: No sooner had the meeting started ___ the power went off.
quiz.why_uz: No sooner doim than bilan keladi, chunki sooner qiyosiy shakl.

quiz.q: Hardly had she sat down ___ the phone rang.
quiz.why_uz: Hardly va scarcely when bilan juftlashadi.

quiz.q: 'He didn't know the figures. He ___ the report.'
quiz.why_uz: Salbiy xulosa uchun can’t have ishlatiladi; mustn’t taqiqni bildiradi.

quiz.q: Which sentence means the speaker DID go, but it was unnecessary?
quiz.why_uz: Needn’t have gone — bordim, lekin keraksiz edi. Didn’t need to odatda bormaganni bildiradi.

options: Walking home, the rain caught me.
Walking home, I got caught in the rain.
Walking home, the rain was heavy.
quiz.why_uz: Sifatdosh bo‘lakning egasi bosh gap egasi bilan bir xil bo‘lishi kerak: uyga I ketayotgan edi.

quiz.q: '___ surprised me most was the price.'
quiz.why_uz: Ajratilgan gap What bilan boshlanadi: What surprised me most was…

quiz.q: Choose the correct collocation: 'The team ___ research into sleep patterns.'
quiz.why_uz: Research conduct yoki carry out qilinadi; make research xato birikma.

quiz.q: The new policy has ___ concerns among parents.
quiz.why_uz: Raise o‘timli fe’l: nimanidir ko‘taradi. Rise esa o‘zi ko‘tariladi.

quiz.q: Which word best completes: 'The proposal has ___ support.'
quiz.why_uz: Eng tabiiy birikma widespread support. Big support o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima.

quiz.q: Which is the best hedged academic claim?
options: This proves that everyone is addicted.
The evidence suggests that heavy use may be linked to lower wellbeing.
Everybody knows social media is bad.
Social media is definitely the cause.
quiz.why_uz: Suggests va may — ehtiyotkor, akademik ifoda. Qolganlari haddan tashqari qat’iy.

quiz.q: In the meeting, Dilnoza says: 'Let's pencil in April.' What does this mean?
options: April must be written in pen.
quiz.why_uz: Pencil in — vaqtincha, keyin o‘zgartirish mumkin bo‘lgan kelishuv.

quiz.q: 'The results are, at best, inconclusive.' The writer's attitude is…
quiz.why_uz: At best — eng yaxshi holatda ham, ya’ni muallif shubhada: sceptical.
Information sanalmaydi va birlikda keladi. Qolganlarida: explained the problem to me, discussed the budget, I agree.

quiz.q: Which phrase is most appropriate in a formal essay?
options: A lot of kids wanna study abroad.
quiz.why_uz: It is widely believed that — rasmiy uslub. Kids, wanna, loads, reckon og‘zaki so‘zlar.
